newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese yuan ends down at intraday high vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Chinese yuan ends down at intraday high vs dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at an intraday high of 8.2908 on Friday from Thursday's 8.2905 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on a weak technical correction after a solid gain on Thursday, traders said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2910.
The yuan opened lower at an intraday high of 8.2908 and fell further to move in a range of 8.2910 and 8.2915 for most of the session. It hit a low of 8.2919 before it rose in late trading.
Trading was dull with most business done at about 8.2915, traders said.
Traders said the yuan fell for most of the session on Friday on a technical correction, but buying at low levels saw it close only slightly down.
"Buying just above the 8.2920 level supported the yuan and made it close at the day's highs," one trader said.

Traders said the yuan was unlikely to breach the key resistance level of 8.2900 or a support of 8.2920 in the short term on a lack of market-moving news. They said they expected the yuan to move around 8.2910 early next week.
The yuan ended down at 7.1550 from 7.1431 vs 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0693 from 1.0710 vs the Hong Kong dollar.
